tooltip.level.flamethrower.desc1: Sprays flames at short range, effective against large groups of low-health entities.
tooltip.level.Rifle.desc1: Holds up to thirty rounds. A reliable choice for long-range engagements.
tooltip.level.bsteel_helmet.desc: A steel tactical helmet that greatly reduces projectile damage.
tooltip.level.bsteel_chestplate.desc: A tactical vest with steel plates inserted, greatly reducing projectile damage.
tooltip.level.rigal_kneepads.desc: Specialized kneepads that reduce some projectile damage and a large amount of magic damage.
tooltip.level.rigal_boots.desc: Specialized boots that reduce some projectile damage and a large amount of magic damage.
